ats_findings.issue: App Transport Security AllowsArbitraryLoads is allowed
ats_findings.description: App Transport Security restrictions are disabled for all network connections. Disabling ATS means that unsecured HTTP connections are allowed. HTTPS connections are also allowed, and are still subject to default server trust evaluation. However, extended security checks like requiring a minimum Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol version—are disabled. This setting is not applicable to domains listed in NSExceptionDomains.
